# S4 — Bound `/var/tmp` growth and alarm on tmp saturation

## Why
`/var/tmp` is a root-volume accumulator from the incident. Age-only cleanup is not enough if the generator can fill the disk before files age out, and aggregate root alarms do not identify tmp saturation.

## What
Add `/var/tmp` age cleanup plus an actual size ceiling compatible with the host filesystem. Use systemd-tmpfiles for age cleanup, and implement the byte cap with a quota-capable mount/path or a bounded host cleanup service/timer if tmpfiles alone cannot enforce size on the deployed filesystem. Extend observability to publish `/var/tmp` usage/cap and add a dedicated CloudWatch alarm.

## Scope
In scope: tmpfiles/timer/quota configuration, observability metric, Terraform alarm, runbook policy, and tests. Out of scope: `/var/gerrit` data-volume probe policy (linked sibling `scowlful-bovine-dragonfly`), review scratch volume, Docker cache, journald, and writable container layers.

## Grounding
- Current observability reports only aggregate filesystems: `infra/scripts/observability.sh:72-90`.
- systemd-tmpfiles docs support age-based cleanup entries and btrfs qgroup helpers, but qgroup helpers do not create an XFS byte cap by themselves.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `/var/tmp` has documented age cleanup and an actual enforced size ceiling on the Gerrit host.
- [ ] The implementation states why the chosen size mechanism works on AL2023/root filesystem assumptions.
- [ ] Observability publishes `/var/tmp` usage/cap metrics and Terraform adds a dedicated alarm wired to SNS.
- [ ] Runbook documents safe remediation and forbids `/var/gerrit` as generic investigation scratch.
- [ ] Targeted tests cover cleanup/quota/timer config, metric emission, and alarm wiring.
- [ ] Portability criterion: uses Linux host-level facilities and local tests; no GitHub-only CI signal is introduced.

## Design Ambiguity
The approved design names "systemd-tmpfiles age+size". Tmpfiles supplies age cleanup, but on root/XFS a separate byte-cap mechanism may be needed; the implementing story must choose and justify that mechanism.
